title: Multi-output directed acyclic circuit
statement: For a natural number $n$, a multi-output directed acyclic circuit consists of a list of gates in topological order, a list of output vertices, a proof that each gate reads only earlier vertices, and a proof that every listed output is a vertex among the $n$ input vertices and the gate vertices.
hypotheses_covered: Gates are listed in topological order and read only earlier vertices
Every output is less than $n$ plus the number of gates
